detail.title: GM810 Pro RGB Wireless Gaming Mouse - White
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GM810 Pro delivers complete freedom from cables with wireless performance that matches high-end wired mice for reaction time and responsiveness. Its magnetic wireless charging dock features vibrant RGB underglow, letting you simply place the mouse down to begin charging without fumbling for cables, and a switch to wired mode is available anytime for zero-latency competitive play. A sleek matte finish contrasts with a bright RGB rim around the base, customizable in effect, colour and brightness through dedicated software, with logo colours that can even change based on the active DPI setting. Ergonomically shaped with anti-slip flanks, it suits palm, claw or fingertip grips comfortably, working across PC as well as PS4/PS5 consoles.
